everyone.summary: 77.8 million more adults vote. Alabama, Massachusetts, Mississippi, South Carolina flip, but Reagan still wins, 451–87. The closest call is Tennessee, which holds for Reagan by 0.2 points. Carter wins in 0 of 100 draws.
assumptions: Every adult votes. Non-citizens choose like naturalized citizens of their state and sex; Black Southerners like Black voters outside the South; everyone else as their group did in 1980.
howIGotThis: What changed: Every adult can vote, and turns out.
New voters borrow the behaviour of naturalized citizens of the same state and sex; Black voters outside the South.
